DisputeVotesCast.meaning: Filing opens the panel case in the same transaction. Votes cast on another case are not read.

ReleaseNotAuthorized.meaning: Only the payer can release an open escrow; after an upheld dispute, the payer or the payee.

DisputePending.meaning: Release stays blocked while the dispute is unresolved or was unwound. A refund before the escrow ends stays blocked until the panel unwinds the deal. A refund also stays blocked when the panel upheld the deal.
